hook: Five Treasury subdomains taken over for three dollars each

beats.say: Researchers cycled through AWS Elastic IPs and took over five US Treasury subdomains, then reported and fixed them through a bug bounty.
A dangling DNS record pointing at a released Elastic IP lets anyone claim that address, and with it the subdomain.
They covered under one percent of the address space and still found 28 high-impact takeovers, so check your DNS records now.
